changelog: The bundled SMS package (creativebranding/sms, in src/Vendor/Sms) is v1.1.0, which adds Account::missing(): what text messages still need (account except for Brevo, token, sender except for ClickSend). Account::ready() now reads it, with the same rule as before.

phpcs.xml: the pattern for Composer's vendor/ is case-sensitive ((?-i)/vendor/), so it no longer also matches src/Vendor/; src/Vendor/ is excluded on its own line, since the shared packages copied there are linted in their own repositories. Plugin Check still scans them in the release zip.
